_comment: Two interpolation surfaces live in this file. (1) Generator-time: tokens like Compute Manager are uppercase-snake-case placeholders replaced by `template-manager generate` before the scenario is built — they appear as literal display values at runtime. (2) Runtime: tokens like {{count}} are i18next interpolation, replaced by `t(key, { count })` at render time. Keys that start with an underscore (like this one) are sentinels — skipped by the codegen, parity test, and unused-key audit.

akash.title: Akash
akash.priceStale: No fresh valid sourced price is available
akash.blockedReasonMissing: Compute Manager did not return a specific blocker reason
akash.actionsDisabled: Setup actions are disabled until Compute Manager returns verified prerequisites and an explicit live effect gate.
akash.descriptorMissing: Compute Manager has not returned an Akash provider descriptor or readiness record. Network, effect mode, signer verification, price status, and blocker are not available from the server.
akash.noActions: No setup, verification, or provider action is available; no readiness or cost is inferred.
akash.noOffer: No server-returned offer or region target is available for verification.
akash.noPriceFact: No price fact was returned by Compute Manager; no provider cost is inferred.
akash.walletIdentifierCaveat: This descriptor is only an identifier. It does not prove the credential exists, belongs to a wallet, or can sign. Enter only an existing sandbox-2 wallet credential through secure Vrooli Onboarding; this step does not create or import a wallet.
akash.marketApiKeyCaveat: The official Akash Console bids endpoint requires an x-api-key and an existing deployment dseq. Enter only an existing key through secure Vrooli Onboarding; Compute Manager will not create a key, account, or deployment.
akash.marketApiKeyNextStep: If you already have an Akash account but no key, create a key in Console Settings → API Keys, then enter it through secure Vrooli Onboarding.

request.title: Request capacity
request.description: Choose a provider offer and lifetime. The stored quote and cap decision are shown with the request result.
request.estimate: A stored quote and cap decision are required before any provider call. Missing or stale price facts refuse the request.
request.error: The request did not complete. Review the persisted quote and decision before retrying.
request.priceUnavailable: No verified provider price was stored. The amount remains unknown; no zero price is inferred.
request.receiptMissing: No stored receipt is available yet. Keep this request reference for a safe retry.
request.receiptPending: This request remains open and may need reconciliation. Do not start another request until it reaches a terminal state.
request.receiptNote: Admission is the cap decision; it does not by itself confirm a server was created. Reusing this request reference will not issue a duplicate create call.

adoption.title: Adopt an existing VPS
adoption.description: Record an operator-owned VPS for Compute Manager. The host remains yours; this form never accepts an SSH password.
adoption.intro: Enter non-secret target and explicit monthly billing facts. The stored quote and cap decision are shown after submission.
adoption.monthlyCostMinor: Monthly total in minor currency units
adoption.monthlyCostInvalid: Enter a non-negative whole number of minor currency units.
adoption.currencyInvalid: Enter a three-letter ISO currency code.
adoption.taxBasisRequired: State whether the declared total is pre-tax or tax-inclusive.
adoption.releaseSemantics: Release removes only the Compute Manager record and Bridge attachment. It never deletes or changes your VPS.
adoption.verificationPending: Enrollment is not verified yet, so this host is not ready for deployment.
adoption.createFailed: Adoption could not be recorded. Retry with the same request reference after checking the stored decision.
adoption.credentialStepUnavailable: The secure first-touch onboarding destination is not enabled yet. No password was requested or sent.
